prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: three matching transparent item icons for an illustrated Mars expedition game. Input image 1 is the existing pale local ice core and insulated version, supplied ONLY for their icy material and modest foil/felt wrapping. Input image 2 is the existing remote ice core, supplied ONLY for its unmistakable continuous rusty brown sediment band. Change their camera to STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE ELEVATION: longitudinal cylinders perfectly horizontal, top and bottom edges parallel, both ends shown edge-on as vertical boundaries. Absolutely NO visible circular or elliptical cut face, no three-quarter view, no perspective, no diagonal axis.
Create a transparent atlas with THREE wide isolated objects arranged in three rows with generous clear gaps, equal long-axis length and corresponding core diameter: top a pale translucent blue-white ice drill core with sparse tiny flecks; middle the SAME local cylinder with a close-fitting thin silver reflective foil and beige felt wrap, tied by a simple narrow cloth band near centre, leaving a short 10% length strip of icy material uncovered at its right end IN SIDE PROFILE (not a visible end face); bottom a clearly icy remote drill core with a continuous rich rusty-brown sediment band running lengthwise through its centre. All three axis exactly horizontal and matching. Profiles roughly 4.8 times longer than their diameter. Ice should have soft frosted crystalline surface and bubbles, no organisms, no glass vial, no hardware or caps. Wrap is modest and close-fitting, no bulky collar, no broad bow, no giant strap tails. Match expedition illustration style, soft dimensional material shading, warm off-white highlights but no dramatic drop shadow.
Transparent background, no grid, no labels, no extra objects. These will be extracted and placed into a very compact mission rack. The two cylinders must look recognizable as ice, not a case. End surfaces invisible because camera is exactly perpendicular to their long axes. Entire objects contained inside image with transparent margins.
